kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننفرث (form VII)
# نَنْفَرِثُ (nanfariṯu) /nan.fa.ri.θu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# نَنْفَرِثَ (nanfariṯa) /nan.fa.ri.θa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# نَنْفَرِثْ (nanfariṯ) /nan.fa.riθ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
